projects.name: The ovarian paper
projects.status: CDK4/6 inhibitor cocktail in ovarian cancer cells. RNA-seq and ChIP-seq data now on HRI (June 17); processed ovarian RNA-seq (STAR, Oct 2024) located, pending confirmation it's the cocktail samples. Tier 2 ChIP sequenced in the June run; Tier 1 ChIP to pull from BaseSpace. Westerns being repeated again (Paul requested; Zach learning) — this round with total-protein (Q) normalization. Draft so far: outline + 2 intro drafts + methods draft; no full draft yet. Urgent next step: figure drafts (DESeq2/volcano/PCA/MA), even on incomplete data, to surface what needs repeating.
projects.short: CDK4/6 inhibitor cocktail in ovarian cancer cells.

projects.name: The CRISPR paper
projects.status: palbociclib + nocodazole synergy for CRISPR/HDR rates (enhancing CRISPR efficiency / HDR outcomes). **Data collection NOT complete:** ≥2 transfections remain (HT1080 + HEPG2 long HDR) and most ddPCR samples still need running. ddPCR so far (HEYA8 only): palbo alone and noc alone ~3–5 hits/µL; palbo+noc ~12–15 hits/µL — synergistic effect. ddPCR probes ordered; consumables/plasticware still needed. T7 on HEYA8 gRNA-only (June 18) inconclusive — likely low DSB rate (controls cut fine).
projects.short: palbociclib + nocodazole synergy for CRISPR/HDR rates (enhancing CRISPR efficiency / HDR outcomes).

projects.name: The review
projects.status: systematic review with pooled analysis of CDK4/6 inhibitors in non-breast/non-haematological solid tumors. RB1 pathway integrity framing (see `review/strategic-reframe-napkin.md`). With Dallas (also her masters report). Dissertation Chapter 1. Target journal: Cancer Treatment Reviews (primary), European Journal of Cancer (secondary). Pipeline: Zotero (dedup) → Covidence (screening) → Elicit (AI-assisted extraction, verify manually) → R + metafor (meta-analysis). Risk of bias: Newcastle-Ottawa (observational) + RoB 2 (RCTs).
projects.short: systematic review with pooled analysis of CDK4/6 inhibitors in non-breast/non-haematological solid tumors.
